title: Shark
wikitext:
[[image:Shark.png|thumb|A coral shark]][[Image:Hammerhead Shark WoW.jpg|thumb|Hammerhead shark]]
A large aquatic fish-like creature.  They are elite and patrol the coastlines of several zones.

Sharks, like all truly marine beasts, cannot be [[tame]]d by [[Hunter]]s.
